mapper.select: SELECT t1.browser, SUM(t1.cnt) AS total_cnt, ROUND(SUM(t1.cnt) * 100.0 / IFNULL(MAX(t2.total_cnt), 1), 2) AS ratio_value FROM t_link_browser_stats t1 JOIN ( SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM t_link_browser_stats WHERE full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} AND date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND del_flag = 0 AND browser != '未知浏览器' ) t2 WHERE t1.full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} AND t1.date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND t1.del_flag = 0 AND t1.browser != '未知浏览器' GROUP BY t1.browser ORDER BY total_cnt DESC
